notes:
- **Bigger Studio plan**: Studio now includes 14,000,000 tokens in your first month, then 7,000,000 every month.
- **Big requests no longer fail**: the Assistant now receives its answer as a live stream, so large requests can't time out with "Could not reach the servers", and you see the answer arrive ("Writing the answer - 18,400 characters so far"). Stop ends a request instantly.
- **Big requests are built in parts you control**: a large request (a whole minigame, a full system) is delivered as a working core first. A "Next steps" card lists what is left, and **Continue with the next part** builds the next piece - nothing runs on by itself for minutes any more.
- **Continue after a problem**: if a request fails (connection lost, server busy) or you stop it, press **Continue** on the message or **Resume** in the message box to send it again - no retyping. While the Assistant is working, the button queues your next message.
- **Code first, art in the studios**: the Assistant now writes the code and data, and the app gives every new item, block and mob a placeholder texture straight away, so everything shows up in game. Paint the real textures in the Texture Studio and build 3D models and animations in the 3D Studio - big requests finish much faster and use far fewer tokens.
- **New mobs work in game right away**: a new mob gets a renderer on a vanilla model until you build its GeckoLib model in the 3D Studio and connect it with one click.
- **New: Export**: next to Run Mod (and on the Build & Run page). Save the ready-to-play **mod file (.jar)** - built for you with Gradle - or the **project files (.zip)**. Pick the folder to save to; if your mod has converted versions, choose which ones or **All versions** and they're saved together in one ZIP.
- **Test every converted version in the app**: each version the Version Converter makes is now also kept as a project. Pick it in the new **Version** list next to Run Mod to build, run and fix it - one by one.
- **Version Converter: you choose the repair rounds**: fix compile errors for up to 1, 2, 3, 5 or 10 rounds, or **until it compiles** - it stops by itself if the same errors keep coming back.
- **Stop means stop**: Stop now ends an AI request immediately - even while it is still connecting or waiting to start.
- **Fixed**: closing the game window (or stopping a run) was treated as a crash and sent to the AI to "repair", wasting tokens. A stopped run is never repaired now.
- **Fixed**: the project card could show another project's loader build (for example "Forge 21.1" for a Forge 1.16.5 mod).
- **Fixed**: drop-down lists (like the version pickers) now show their arrow.
- **Clearer usage**: under each answer you now see just the tokens used and how long it took.
- **Version Converter**: old Fabric versions now get exactly the right Minecraft, Yarn and Fabric API versions in their template.
